reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication needed
reauth_confirm.description: The Google Health Workouts integration needs to re-authenticate your Google account.

abort.missing_activity_scope: You did not grant access to your activity and fitness data. Re-authenticate and grant the activity scope.
abort.missing_profile_scope: You did not grant access to your profile data. Re-authenticate and grant the profile scope.
abort.api_not_enabled: The Google Health API is not enabled in your Google Cloud project. Enable it at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/health.googleapis.com
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Google Health.
abort.wrong_account: The Google account you authenticated with does not match the previously configured account.

error.oauth_error: Could not set up the OAuth flow. Check that your application credentials are correct.
error.auth_error: Google Health authentication failed. Re-authenticate the integration.
error.communication_error: Failed to communicate with the Google Health API.
